plugins.name: meeting-scheduler
plugins.description: Draft Outlook meeting invitations, or check availability and create Teams meetings through a calendar connector after confirmation.

plugins.name: push-skill-to-github
plugins.description: Publish or update an Agent Skill in the xilverkamui/agent-skills GitHub repo, following the repo's versioning rules.

plugins.name: simple-suggestion
plugins.description: Draft an LNK Simple Suggestion (Kaizen) from a short description of an implemented improvement and fill the official FRM-DCI-001 Excel form with an ANAKONDA sheet.

plugins.name: minutes-of-meeting
plugins.description: Turn meeting notes, transcripts, or connected meeting sources into a scannable Indonesian MoM, with an optional reply-all email draft to the meeting invitation.
